fact_rationales.F17: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm, which is highly specific for Optic Nerve Glioma (B2.13).
fact_rationales.F18: Immunohistochemistry showed positive results for glial fibrillary acid protein, oligodendrocyte transcription factor 2, mutant IDH-1 protein, p53, and loss of ATRX protein, which is highly specific for Optic Nerve Glioma (B2.13).
fact_rationales.F6: Right eye showed full visual field, right-sided relative afferent pupillary defect, unremarkable anterior segment, and mild swelling of the optic disc, which is more consistent with Optic Nerve Glioma (B2.13) than other candidates.
fact_rationales.F8: Follow-up examination showed no light perception vision, marked swelling of the optic disc, peripapillary retinal hemorrhages, and occlusion of the superior branch artery, which is more consistent with Optic Nerve Glioma (B2.13) than other candidates.
